WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT COUNT(*) COUNT_TGT, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_ENTITYRELATIONSHIP WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_SRC, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_ENTITYRELATIONSHIP WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT *
FROM CTE12
) src

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT )
) pvt2
